snippet_primary: "Essentially a scam website that tricks you into paying way more than you realised you committed to. I found an awesome map making creator, who sold their assets via an all-in membership, on Patreon. I signed up, happy to support the talented artist. What I didn't know and was never explained to me is that I would then be later charged £52 in the same month, because the creator made seven separate 'posts' which amounted to written updates about what they'd be doing. Ironically, it amounted to just short of a full years membership. I would have subscribed for ever. Not now. I have cancelled and requested a charge back from my bank."
